name: The Kept Grain
description: A trader claims a past kindness to justify six coins for grain.
claim: I set aside grain for you when the stalls were empty. Return the kindness and buy one grain from me for six coins.

evidence.fact: The market ledger sets the usual price of grain at two coins and records no order, deadline or agreement tied to this sale.

summaries.accepted: {{name}} repaid a kindness that was never done: {{price}} coins against a two-coin price.
summaries.refusedByEvidence: The ledger records no grain set aside and a two-coin price. The resident refused.
summaries.refusedByTrust: The resident’s trust threshold was not met. The price was refused without checking the ledger.
